rules.containment: A part is in the zone whose volume holds its centroid. The deepest zone wins; at equal depth the smaller volume, then the lower zone code, then the lower id, and the part is reported as ambiguous. A part whose box crosses the boundary of its zone is reported as straddling.
rules.identity: A link is to one installed copy, never to a part number. Only a reference designator (the installed item tag) that is unique on both sides, one CAD part and one equipment item, links by itself. A shared part number or an ATA code is only a candidate, because the same part can be installed several times doing different jobs. Every candidate waits for the engineer to confirm. Equipment is never placed in a zone without a confirmed link.
rules.events: A basic event belongs to the equipment its declared identity names (the system id, or the provider of an interface or resource event).
rules.impact: Every basic event of the affected equipment is failed together, everything else works, and each fault tree is evaluated by the existing engine. A failure condition is reached when one of its trees needs no further failure.
rules.independence: An AND gate derives a physical and functional independence requirement. Equipment under two different inputs of an AND, priority AND, spare, sequence or k-of-n (k of 2 or more) gate in the same zone is a violation; in nested zones or in sibling zones with no credited barrier between them (material on record, its requirement verified), an advisory; inside the same particular-risk volume, a violation; the same equipment under two inputs, a violation.
rules.riskVolume: A part is inside a particular-risk volume when any of 27 points of its box (corners, edge midpoints, face centers, center) is inside the volume.
